decisions.statement: A folder with no page of its own is refused.
A folder with a page more than the one it answers for is refused.
Which second page the folder answers for is handed in.
A file in the folder that is no part of the page is refused.
Which files are parts is handed in.
A folder named other than what its page calls it is refused.
Nothing here judges the folders under the folder.
Nothing here judges what page type the page is.
A folder named its page's slug with the names of every page above taken off is right.
A name is taken off for every folder above holding a page rather than for the nearest alone.
A folder named the plural the page's own page type gathers its pages under is right.
A folder named a plural gathering the pages of the page's own slug is right too.
A page whose slug a plural gathers is the page type that plural gathers.
A folder named a plural gathering neither is refused for its name.

definition: what the shapes of a folder headed by one page all say alike
